description: X5.11 acceptance of pendulum-double-fixed. The reference numbers are design/design.py's independent sampled-data integration (CVODES on the non-linear design model with the winding current) of the same control law and tables, with the disturbance; the bond-graph run reproduces its link angles to about 1e-4 rad over the whole scenario. Model `free` is the plant without the controller, started away from the hanging position: its joint angles are compared with the design ODE, which proves that the design model is the bond graph.
